source_review.notes: Checked Hohpe/Woolf and current EIP Publish-Subscribe Channel page, current Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ publish/subscribe and acknowledgements/confirms documentation, current NATS documentation, current AWS SNS subscription/retry documentation, CloudEvents, and Kleppmann. Product-specific delivery/retention claims are scoped; end-to-end recommendations state premises.

evidence: Checked subscription snapshot/obligation set, per-subscription delivery/effect counts, fan-out work sum, lag/rate/retention notation and group-instance distinction.
Confirmed product-specific membership/retention semantics are explicit assumptions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The model does not imply one global ack, effect or exactly-once property.

evidence: Recomputed two durable obligations, zero inactive transient obligation, billing attempt one and search attempts two.
Confirmed final subscription-scoped effect set has cardinality two despite three delivery attempts.
Checked six-system and catch-up examples contain no unsupported quantitative guarantees.
numerical_recomputation.notes: No real rate, byte, lag, retention or cost dataset was executed.

evidence: Verified O(m,t) independently selects matched subscriptions and group instances do not multiply logical obligations.
Confirmed D_(m,s)>=1 does not imply E_(m,s)=1 without subscription-scoped idempotency.
Derived snapshot-plus-watermark bootstrap conditions and replay distinction from stated premises.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No liveness claim holds beyond retention/availability/capacity/schema/security assumptions.

evidence: Reviewed transient/durable/late subscribers, filter changes, group versus instance, producer/outbox gap, effect-before-ack crash, duplicates, per-group lag/DLQ, retry, retention gap, snapshot bootstrap, replay of irreversible effects, ordering/rebalance and slow group/downstream saturation.

Reviewed schema critical-field evolution, wildcard subscriptions, cross-tenant/purpose/field disclosure, subscription deletion to hide lag, fan-out/cost growth, ownerless groups and critical clinical-result reactions/corrections.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real broker, database, network, workload, security, privacy, regulation and clinical evidence remain required.

evidence: Traced event suitability, subscription ownership, outbox publication, independent effect/ack, stable identity/schema/key, ordering, slow-group isolation, security and lifecycle through exposition/examples/answers.
Checked finite model creates independent queues, no email obligation, separate ack state and one set effect per subscription.
invariant_checking.notes: The set/effect and ack are not atomic or durable in the snippet and are labeled accordingly.

evidence: Reviewed publish membership, billing delivery/effect/ack, search failure/redelivery/dedupe/ack and final cardinalities line by line.
Reviewed counterexamples for global ack, new-subscriber history, retention guarantee, global order, replay safety and free subscriptions.
proof_review.notes: No broker durability, distributed transaction, security, performance or clinical proof is claimed.

evidence: Audited every, independent, durable, retained, delivered, acknowledged, replayable, ordered, exactly once, safe, proof, invariant and conclusion language.
Confirmed broker, subscriber effect, capacity, security, replay and human-review evidence categories remain separate.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Strong claims name group, identity, retention, transaction, key/version, authorization or review premises.

evidence: Reproduced obligation list, independent progress, redelivery attempts and two effects.
Recorded that no real broker, database transaction, retention, rebalance, filtering, auth/privacy, load, replay or external effect was executed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Execution establishes one deterministic in-memory pub/sub trace only.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter distinguishes publish-subscribe from point-to-point, competing consumer instances, recipient lists, transient broadcast, durable queues, retained logs/groups, filters and direct callbacks while separating fact publication from command ownership.

practitioner_review.notes: Guidance covers subscriptions/membership, durability/outbox/inbox, independent progress, delivery/order/filter, slow-group isolation, retry/DLQ, retention/replay/bootstrap, schema/security/cost/lifecycle, telemetry, real testing and high-stakes fan-out.

pedagogical_review.notes: Objectives align with obligation/delivery/effect/fan-out notation, a runnable independent-subscription model, ten distinct examples, and five complete exercises spanning membership, invoice design, snapshot bootstrap, platform diagnosis and clinical transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
